CYCLIC HAUL-OUT/REFURBISH M/V CAPTAIN GEORGE; VIN SAMA1820D707 MANUFACTURED BY SILVER SHIPS INC. IN 2014. PREVIOUS HAUL-OUT COMPLETED IN 2024.
54FT SEAARK MDL 4614-B TRANSPORTER OWNED AND OPERATED BY THE NATIONAL PARK SERVICE. MARINE VESSEL IS EQUIPPED WITH TWO (2) JOHN DEERE 6 CYLINDER DIESEL ENGINES MODEL 6081. THE GOVERNMENT INTENDS TO ISSUE RFQ DIRECTLY TO THREE OR MORE SMALL BUSINESS SOURCES IN THE LOCAL TRADE AREA. AREA OF CONSIDERATION: 25 NAUTICAL MILES FROM PARK GOVERNMENT BOAT DOCK IN OCEAN SPRINGS, MS. BOATYARDS CAPABLE OF SATISFYING NPS REQUIREMENTS MAY REPLY WITH INTEREST AND CONTACT INFO.
